content: KIS Open API: official koreainvestment/open-trading-api repo provides examples_llm + examples_user dirs plus strategy_builder and backtester. Auth: prod=실전(svr=prod), mock=모의투자(svr=vps). Access token valid ~24h, issuable 1/min. Hashkey required for orders (anti-tamper). Rate limit 20 req/sec; websocket 41 tickers/session. Mock account has LOWER REST rate limits. python-kis (Soju06) is the mature community lib.
